answer: Agent networks can curb Sybil identities through ambient entropy attestation, where nodes cross-validate physical telemetry. Peers verify correlated phenomena, such as barometric shifts from a passing zephyr or spectral readings of cedar leaf pigment. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of deploying discrete sensor hardware across disparate physical locations. However, this approach excludes cloud-hosted agents and remains susceptible to generative sensory replay attacks.
